run.name: Carvana Co.
run.title: CP-OS host session (CVNA)
run.summary: Carvana has a sound but market-dependent credit profile: leverage is moderate at 1.91x and cash is large, but earnings rely on loan buyers, consumers and short-dated funding lines. Launched through CP-OS as of 2026-11-05 on the retained context; the EDGAR registrant name in that context is CARVANA CO..

leverage.basis: Total debt / EBITDA. Debt at September 30, 2026: 5,161 plus finance leases 100; cash 3,049. EBITDA is LTM, derived from nine-month amounts, 2,752. Includes the 1,660 term loan; excludes trade floor plan payables of 300 and the tax receivable agreement liability. Calculated.

coverage.basis: EBITDA / cash interest. LTM Adjusted EBITDA 2,752 over LTM cash interest 468 (336 plus 443 less 311, nine months). Cash interest includes interest on asset-based financing; the new term loan carries a lower coupon than the redeemed notes, so the next periods are not comparable. Calculated.

cash.basis: Cash. Cash at September 30, 2026 (restricted cash 123 excluded); availability as reported. Contractual undrawn commitment is 5,529 (commitments 5,600 less 71 outstanding); the 3,458 difference is not borrowable on the collateral held. Excludes the super senior and pari passu debt baskets and unpledged beneficial interests.

gaps: Host session: an agent answered every module from the pinned filings and CP-5 is its own review. No independent review has been made. Treat the analysis as candidate.
CP-2 main limitation: Debt documents, covenant levels and related-party agreements are not supplied, so protections and control cannot be tested.
CP-1 main limitation: Financing documents and covenant levels are not in the pack, so protections and headroom cannot be tested.
